key.name: style
key.description: Bubble tint style: iridescent, multicolor, transparent or custom.

key.name: custom-color
key.description: Hex color used when the bubble style is set to custom.

key.name: bubble-size
key.description: Average bubble radius as a percentage of the smallest screen dimension.

key.name: bubble-size-variation
key.description: Random variation around the average size, in percent.

key.name: bubble-speed
key.description: Cruising speed as a percentage of the smallest screen dimension per second.

key.name: spawn-interval
key.description: Average delay between two bubbles entering, in seconds.

key.name: activation-delay
key.description: Idle time before the screensaver starts, in seconds.

key.name: fade-delay
key.description: Seconds of transparent phase before the background fades to black.

key.name: suspend-delay
key.description: Idle minutes before the extension asks logind to suspend the system. 0 disables it.

key.name: explode-on-exit
key.description: Replace the bubbles with a droplet cloud when the screensaver is dismissed.

key.name: test-now
key.description: Set by the preferences button to launch the screensaver immediately.
